entry_points.text: Generic context: lazy TLB entry, empty destroy and deactivate, always-ok init, activate forwards spaces to machine switch.
Hyper-V fallbacks report uninitialized or unsupported with zero trust level; status formatters add caller, code and message.
Switch delegates to architecture code yielding prior task; soft interrupts run core handler on owned stack.

exports.text: Hyper-V helpers decode status, test success and repetition, advise events, translate CPUs to VPs, and build banked sets failing on invalid entries.
Generic NUMA and topology queries give distance, CPU sets, CPU to node bindings and bus bindings, with setters for associations.
Generic PCI always shows domains, denies I/O memory maps, leaves unmap empty, and maps I/O ports in only one build.
Raw per-CPU layer offers generic read, update, exchange and compare plus sized 1/2/4/8 and 64/128-bit compare and try forms.
Checked per-CPU accessors give sized read, store, add, bitwise, add-return, exchange, compare and try-compare including wide forms.
Portable shims give zero cycle fallback, shared vdso time and random pointers, and filesystem identity.
Framebuffer helpers tune protection to write combining, report not primary, and delegate sized loads, stores, copies and fills.

hazards.text: Discard partial VP sets on overflow or invalid lookup; bound repeats and handle early failure as progress needs success.
Generics are degenerate: PCI absent, Hyper-V uninitialized, cycles zero, single node, bus missing, video not primary, vdso inert.
Over-capacity advances count without storing so unwind tolerates gaps; order record, attempt, word-clear, tracking-clear with barriers.

invariants.text: ELF names bind as a group to wide or narrow types, lock name selects queued or local type, per-CPU forwards by width, qualifier empty.
Guest ID packs vendor and version, partition tests use root/L1VH with parent disjunction, unsupported without parent, virt resilience off.
Single-node defaults zero CPU bindings, use online masks, miss bus lookup, discard setters, empty hooks, and leave vdso clock inert.
Per-CPU offsets index a table with raw and guarded current forms and build-selected base section; headers carry include-once markers.
Initial limits bound stack, zero core and signals, default files and queues, and compat mode allows only read, write, exit and sigreturn.
Containment needs full inclusion, overlap any intersection, init helpers use init bounds, and kernel tests separate data, text and overall ranges.
Linker groups main text variants, data families, ordered scheduler classes, initial task, jump tables, and aggregated writable and read-only outputs.
Bounded helpers emit kept inputs between markers; device-tree, ACPI, LSM, tracing, profiling and exception tables exist only when enabled.

locks.text: Mmiowb hooks track barrier demand only without exclusion; updates stay on one context with outer exit draining pending.
Checked per-CPU ops guard migration and interrupts; raw forms guard nothing and need caller protection.
Resilient acquire records before attempting with queued wait on contention; release clears word before tracking.
Raw wrappers init unlocked with preempt and IRQ suppression; tracking relies on external write, per-CPU, barrier and atomic helpers.

state_machines.text: Enabled mmiowb deepens on entry, stages pending when nonzero, drains via barrier at outer exit; disabled build empty.
Repeat hypercall loops from start advancing by completed count with liveness touches until done or immediate failure; wrapper starts zero.
Attempt goes idle-recorded-locked or waiting then held or idle with unwind; release goes held-unlocked-idle.

structs.text: Mmiowb state has nesting and pending counters, module record empty, cycles unsigned word, descriptors map by identity with address field.
Hyper-V info aggregates features, hints, isolation and availability with guest/root/L1VH kinds; TPM base hex fed40000, invalid VP max u32.
MSI info bundles descriptor, hardware number, flags and two scratch slots; depth two, proxy bit zero, fixed-data bit one, generic ops marked.
Resilient lock is one word dual-view, BPF wrapper one aligned u32, tracking count plus 31 pointers, timeout quarter second.
Thread flags 0-12 cover resume, signal, notify, memdie, reschedule, lazy, polling, user-return, probe, patch, sigmask, rseq and timer rearm.
Block budget twice max nodes, ticks follow config, PCI minima zero with full assignment, shm aligns to page, load bias zero, struct align 32.
